rights.notes: Rights unverified. A B2B pitch; reuse the full-stop bloom, counter-and-stamp and arrow-to-logo match principles only, with original marks and data.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session F) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), transitions strips at all 5 boundaries (every 2nd frame), the listen sheet (10 accent hits; no speech phrases) and a 30 fps strip at 5.90-7.20 s (the counter and the stamp). The 7.8-9.1 s strip was generated but not viewed. Signal features and Windows en-US dictation; nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 15.02 s (1280x720, 60 fps); all boundaries at 2-frame steps; the counter and stamp at 30 fps.

concept.observed: A pitch to brands from a wholesale reseller: your brand deserves better than a price war; too many sellers, the price slides; we protect the price; we buy upfront; we rebuild your listings; one partner for every marketplace; scale; logo.
concept.interpreted: Problem, then four promises, each with one proof object.

communication_style.observed: Music only; two-line heavy caps headlines, line 2 in an accent colour.

palette.observed: Dark navy and teal-blues (#081828, #080818, #082838); electric blue accent and glows; red for the problem section; a green stamp; white listing cards.

typography.observed: Heavy condensed caps, two lines of 1-3 words, line 2 in blue (or red for problems); tabular numerals in cards; tiny corner labels.

composition.observed: Headline left or top-left, proof card right or centred; connector diagram centred-left to three cards right; HUD corner labels and a faint dot grid.

motion.observed: The logo badge glows and dims (0-1.4 s); headlines smear out sideways (2.71-2.81 s, 13.06 s); a price ticks down (3.38-3.91 s); a dollar counter rolls with blurred digit slots from about 2,800 to 10,000 (5.90-6.73 s) while ten dots fill; a 'paid' stamp slams down rotated (6.77-6.87 s); a light bar sweeps across a grey listing card and it resolves into a full listing (8.0-9.0 s); the card shrinks into an icon tile (9.69-9.89 s); connectors draw to three marketplace cards (10.0-11.0 s); a line chart rises to an arrow (12.4 s).

transitions.observed: 2.83 s soft: the headline smears off and its blue full stop grows into a full-frame blue disc (2.81-2.91 s, 0.10 s), a dark hole opens inside it and reveals the next scene (2.91-3.01 s). 4.70 s cut with a white glow flash (4.71-4.74 s), problem to solution. 7.50 s soft: a diagonal light band sweeps across (7.44-7.54 s). 9.72 s soft: the listing card shrinks into an icon (container). 13.18 s cut: the chart's arrow tip survives the cut and becomes the logo's arrow (13.09-13.36 s).
transitions.interpreted: Each change is carried by an object: a full stop, a flash, a card, an arrow.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Sections of about 2.8, 1.9, 1.2, 1.9, 2.2, 2.0, 1.5 and 1.8 s; the problem is told in 3.1 s, the promises in 7.5 s.

sound_design.observed: -13.9 LUFS, LRA 4.9 LU, true peak -1.0 dBTP; tempo 64.6 bpm (medium); 48 onsets; 10 accents (40/min). Accents on boundaries 0 of 5 (chance 0.12); onsets within 50 ms of boundaries 0.6 (chance 0.27), median 46 ms; near the beat 0.4 (chance 0.13). Strongest accents: the price ticking down (3.81 s), the counter roll (6.15, 6.62 s), the stamp landing (6.80 s), then a 0.93-0.95 s grid on each promise's proof: the light bar on the listing (8.01 s), the finished listing (8.96 s), card to icon (9.89 s), the connectors (10.84 s), the dissolve (11.77 s). Pre-hit dip: the level falls to -36 dB (film median -16.1 dB) over 1.44-1.90 s between the logo badge and the first headline, back to -14.7 dB at 2.0 s as the headline lands. Head -3.4 dB, tail -10.1 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Cuts on the beat, hits on the proof objects; a short silence separates the logo from the pitch.

narration.observed: None: dictation recognised 0 confident words (16 raw); no speech phrases.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy lanes: two-line caps headlines top-left or left (1-3 words per line, about 2 s each), a centred headline with a sub line (1.9-2.8 s), the logo lockup with a one-line tagline and URL centred at the end.

scenes.observed: Opening statement with a blue full stop.
Problem: too many sellers, price sliding.
We buy upfront: counter to 10,000 and a paid stamp.
Listings rebuilt: a grey card resolves under a light bar.
Scale: a rising chart with an arrow.
The arrow becomes the logo; tagline and URL.

moments.observed: A dollar counter rolls to 10,000 (5.90-6.73 s) and a green rotated stamp slams onto the card (6.77-6.87 s) on the 6.80 s accent.
moments.interpreted: The number lands, then the proof is stamped.
